name: std::regex_token_iterator<BidirIt,CharT,Traits>::operator*, operator->
intro: Returns a pointer or reference to the current match.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1) Returns a reference to the current match.

2) Returns a pointer to the current match.

The behavior is undefined if the iterator is end-of-sequence iterator.
